bullets.text: Police arrested an intoxicated person who entered an Anganwadi center in RK Pet and issued a death threat to the assistant.
Avadi residents suffered severe hardship due to a sudden power outage caused by the local sub-station.
The Thiruvallur district collector announced that the district is fully prepared to face the upcoming northeast monsoon.
Chief Minister will present the Gandhi Adigal Police Medal to five police personnel for excellence in prohibition enforcement work on Republic Day.

stories.title: அங்கன்வாடி உதவியாளருக்கு தொல்லை: போதை நபர் கைது
takeaways: A drunk man threatened an anganwadi assistant in RK Pet within Tiruvallur district.
Local police promptly arrested the accused following the incident at the government center.

stories.title: ஆவடியில் திடீர் மின்வெட்டு
takeaways: Residents faced severe hardship following an unexpected power outage in Avadi Kamarajar Nagar.
Local authorities must address recurring infrastructure issues to prevent public inconvenience in the district.

takeaways: Rural residents lodged a formal complaint against the Tiruninravur electricity board assistant engineer with the collector.
The district administration is expected to review the official conduct following public grievances.

An individual allegedly blocked access to the Melur Veera Anjaneyar temple path.

takeaways: Three government school students from Tiruttani were selected for the national sub-junior cricket tournament.
Their selection follows strong performances at the state-level school cricket championships held in Sivaganga.

stories.title: 5 காவலர்களுக்கு காந்தியடிகள் காவலர் விருது
takeaways: Five police personnel will receive the Gandhi Adigal Police Award from the Chief Minister on Republic Day.
The award recognizes exceptional performance in prohibition enforcement duties across the state.
stories.snippet: 5 காவலர்களுக்கு காந்தியடிகள் காவலர் விருது சென்னை: மதுவிலக்கு அமலாக்கப் பணியில் சிறப்பாக செயல்பட்ட 5 காவல்துறை பணியாளர்களுக்கு காந்தியடிகள் காவலர் விருது முதல்வரால் ஜனவரி 26ம் தேதி குடியரசு தினத்தன்று வழங்கப்படும் என்று…
